mapper.select: select p.profile_id, p.assessment_id, p.visitor_id, p.questionnaire_id, p.undergrad_tier, p.undergrad_university_id, p.gpa_percent, p.class_rank, p.major_relevance, p.english_status, p.ielts_equiv_total, p.ielts_equiv_min_sub, p.std_test_type, p.std_test_total, p.target_degree, p.target_field, p.target_field_group, p.target_countries, p.months_to_intake, cast(p.profile as text) as profile, cast(p.warnings as text) as warnings, p.normalized_time, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from abr_profile p where p.assessment_id = #{assessmentId}
